capabilities: Provide advanced note layout and navigation.
disambiguation: Not a general productivity suite; it is a design and presentation enhancement layer for notes.
extras: No telemetry, no analytics, no ads. Word/PDF import and some exports require the desktop app.
intentEvidence: Works on its own, or together with the Ignorance theme: diagrams, tables, images, presentations and exports in one place.
problem: Standard Markdown lacks advanced features for creating polished presentations, complex diagrams, and professional document exports.

summary: Advanced features for the Ignorance theme, enhancing diagrams, tables, code, and providing comprehensive export and presentation tools.
